title: Turner et al. 2008 NEJM / PubMed: FDA antidepressant trials versus published literature
summary: Peer-reviewed audit comparing FDA review conclusions for antidepressant trials with corresponding journal publications, showing selective publication/outcome reporting and apparent efficacy inflation.
